objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote:
The full expression becomes
$$
(c n - e m)^2 \;+\; \underbrace{4c(c-e)n}_{\text{linear in }n} \;+\; O(n+m) \;\ge\; 0 \qquad (5)
$$
objection.witness: Equation (5) labels the remaining linear terms as O(n+m), which need not be bounded or dominated by the displayed negative term. Along |cn-em|<1 they can be regrouped exactly into O(1), but this necessary calculation is omitted.
